label: Formulated the critique of subjective instrumental reason in Eclipse of Reason and Dialectic of Enlightenment
Co-authored Dialectic of Enlightenment, fusing social theory, philosophical critique, and psychoanalysis to analyze the culture industry
Directly influenced Habermas at the Frankfurt Institute, who later sought to reconstruct Critical Theory on communicative rather than instrumental grounds
Recruited Marcuse to the Institute for Social Research in 1933, collaboratively developing Critical Theory and the critique of modern authority
